text: 下周全球市场将迎来多重重磅事件交织。国内市场方面，A股将于10月8日(周四)结束国庆长假开市。国际宏观与政策端，美联储会议纪要及多位官讲话将透露降息路径，美国9月ISM非制造业数据与失业金人数将验证经济韧性；同时，G7联合释放1亿桶战略油储与中东地缘局势动向将加剧能源市场波动。此外，英特尔调价与芝商所首发GPU算力期货凸显芯片算力产业链新动态，而2026年诺贝尔奖(生理学或医学、物理、化学、文学、和平奖)也将于周内陆续揭晓。 <u>10月5日(周一)：</u> 17:30 2026年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖公布 22:00 美国9月ISM非制造业指数 G7决
text_en: Next week, global markets will see a mix of major events. Domestically, A-shares will reopen on October 8 (Thursday) after the National Day holiday. On the international macro and policy front, the Fed meeting minutes and speeches by several officials will reveal the rate-cut path, while U.S. September ISM non-manufacturing data and jobless claims will test economic resilience; at the same time, the G7's joint release of 100 million barrels of strategic oil reserves and Middle East geopolitical developments will heighten volatility in energy markets. In addition, Intel's price adjustments and CME's first GPU computing power futures highlight new developments in the chip computing power industry chain, while the 2026 Nobel Prizes (Physiology or Medicine, Physics, Chemistry, Literature, Peace) will also be announced during the week. <u>October 5 (Monday):</u> 17:30 Announcement of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 22:00 U.S. September ISM Non-Manufacturing Index G7 decision
